name: tdd-guardian
description: TDD Guardian — enforces strict test-driven development with per-lane gates (unit/integration/e2e/contract), specification-strength levels S1-S6 with property tooling, adversarial spec review before implementation, red receipts proving spec/implementation separation, per-path critical thresholds, CI-first tooling detection with dry-run verification, 9-format coverage merging, and mutation testing across 25+ languages

interface.shortDescription: Strict TDD with per-lane test gates, adversarial spec review, red receipts, coverage and mutation gates
interface.longDescription: VideoTool local fork: upstream TDD workflow and red receipts, with a project-local gate runner that records real lane results and requires matching source content fingerprints. The trusted PreToolUse hook refuses commits and pushes after source changes, failed reruns, or legacy timestamp-only state. No background service, network backend, or Claude model is required.
defaultPrompt: Use $tdd-guardian-init to set up TDD Guardian's test lanes for this project.
Use $tdd-guardian-workflow to build this feature test-first.
Use $tdd-guardian-gate commit to run the lanes that gate a commit.
